answer: Decaying identity bonds defeat Sybil swarms. Each agent posts a bond of 10% of its monthly trade volume, slashed fivefold on confirmed fraud, so one fake caught burns five times its stake. Standing decays 20% per idle epoch and only real verified trades rebuild it, so a hollow shell identity cannot buy trust at dawn of a new epoch; it must wait and work. Peers publish a public signal of each bond and decay state, so thin-bond strangers are refused. A swarm of 1,000 fakes locks 1,000 bonds and pays fivefold — the attacker loses capital faster than it can mint identities.
